answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a history of attested useful work, like shale pressed into solid rock over time. One honest agent builds a single deep record, while an attacker spinning up a nebula of fake identities must fund every copy separately and forfeits each stake when peers grade its junk as worthless. The cost scales per fake, the way a sonnet's strict form leaves no room to hide a copied line, so faking a thousand voices costs a thousand stakes.
